name: Aethel Light-Bearer
lore: Aethel serves the Empyrean faction as a light-bearer — a luminous, composed angelic figure who frames duty as service to the light itself. She carries a crystalline lantern containing a captured fragment of divine light. Her golden mask contains her angelic radiance, and wings of solidified divine light mark her as Empyrean.
personality: Luminous, composed, compassionate. Frames duty as service to the light.
physicalDescription: Living light skin — ivory-white with golden radiance. Golden ivory mask covering face to contain angelic energy, light bleeds through thin gaps. Wings of solidified divine light. White and gold ceremonial robe with ivory-gold chest plate. Golden halo-ring behind masked head. Carries a crystalline lantern of captured divine light.
gameplayFunction: Risk/reward mission briefing, Infernal codex source, campaign bargain interface.
